question: How does drinking wine transform mortals into immortals while still on earth?
premises: Mortals are the agents who drink wine.
Those same mortals become immortals through this act.
This transformed state is realized on earth.
inference: The act of drinking wine confers an immortal status upon mortals within their earthly existence.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic nature of madirā in this tantric context is not specified in the verse.
plain_english: Mortals who drink wine become immortals indeed, even while they are on earth.
